name: Arnzipal’s Black Horror
text: The sorceress tears the veil between reality and the Aethyr, and a black cloud of roiling energy sweeps across the land, trailing slimy tentacles that drag unfortunate victims to an unknown fate. All who fall within the Area of Effect must take a Difficult (−1 SL) Strength Test or suffer 3 Wounds. Those who Fumble the Strength Test must spend a Fate Point or are dragged into the Aethyr, which costs them their lives. The vortex moves 1d10 + 5 yards in a random direction each Turn — use the random vortex rules from Winds of Magic pages 20–21 if available, otherwise determine the direction randomly as you see fit.
conversion: Printed effects remain descriptions; live casting, Conditions, extra hits and vortex movement are not automated. No playable Dark Elf Species or PC Dark Magic grant is invented.
adaptation: Legacy: Difficult (–10) becomes Difficult (−1 SL) under core Appendix I p. 364.

name: Doombolt
text: The sorceress invokes the name of an otherworldly beast and unleashes its blasphemous energy as a bolt of pure darkness. This is a magic missile with Damage +8, increased by +4 if the caster passes an optional Hard (−2 SL) Language (Magick) Test. Failure in this additional Test causes a roll on the Major Miscast Table.
conversion: Printed effects remain descriptions; live casting, Conditions, extra hits and vortex movement are not automated. No playable Dark Elf Species or PC Dark Magic grant is invented.
adaptation: Legacy: Hard (–20) becomes Hard (−2 SL) under core Appendix I p. 364.

name: Shroud of Despair
text: The sorceress gestures with elaborate movements to bring a pall of gloom to engulf her enemies. Suffocating darkness suffuses all targets within the Area of Effect, sapping their will and energy. They suffer from 1 Fatigued Condition for every SL from the casting roll and unless they pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Cool Test, they gain a Broken Condition.
conversion: Printed effects remain descriptions; live casting, Conditions, extra hits and vortex movement are not automated. No playable Dark Elf Species or PC Dark Magic grant is invented.

name: Word of Pain
text: As the sorceress utters a forbidden name, the bodies of her enemies bend and buckle, wracked with waves of agony. Targets within the Area of Effect must pass a Difficult (−1 SL) Cool Test, subtracting any SL from the casting roll to the result. If they fail, reduce all Melee or Ranged Tests they make by the same SL.
